text: At e <= 0.85 and N=64, accel_step forms at steps 60-70 when val_mse_ratio is about 8-10% of its step-0 value. At e <= 0.5 the same N formed at steps 85-90 and about 2-3%. Does the paired N=256 e <= 0.85 arm (seeds 59-61) also form within a similar training-step window? If so, formation timing tracks training steps rather than relative loss reduction, across both N and eccentricity.
